messages.text: For a AI use case involving AI data centers, where would Vector Network Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

建議主軸：For AI data center infrastructure, place the Vector Network Analyzer in the high-speed interconnect / transmission-channel signal-integrity workflow: validating connectors, cables, PCBs/PCBAs, sockets, transmission lines and PDN behavior before or alongside oscilloscope/BERT/system-level tests.[20][26][31]
### 推薦先賣
- AI data center interconnect targets are plausible because data-center server infrastructure uses connectors, cables and high-speed components for high-bandwidth data flow, complex data processing and high-performance computing.[37]
- Specific DUT targets include high-speed backplane connectors positioned for AI data center architectures, such as Amphenol Sentry HD, and high-speed I/O cable systems such as OverPass, which carries high-speed signals from ASIC packages to system endpoints.[2][25][30]
- The VNA fits where the workflow needs insertion loss, return loss, impedance, crosstalk-related SI work, and de-embedding for PCBs, sockets, board-to-board connectors, transmission lines and SoC validation fixtures.[3][20][26][31]
- R&S VNA positioning should be framed as a total measurement solution—VNA plus probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool and local partner—rather than only an instrument-frequency discussion.[3][20]

|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| R&S ZNL20 | Lower-frequency VNA work on components, cables, PCBs or fixtures within its range | 2-port VNA; 5 kHz to 20 GHz; 3.5 mm male test-port connector; model R&S ZNL20 is “Vector network analyzer, 20 GHz, 3.5 mm connectors” | Usable where the required S-parameter / network measurement bandwidth is within 20 GHz | [1][18] | The passages do not state any AI-data-center-specific ZNL20 application, channel-loss target, compliance standard or fixture setup |
| R&S ZNB3044 / R&S ZNA43 | Higher-end R&S VNA families for market application cases | 知識庫未標示規格 in these passages; they are named as R&S products appearing in market application cases | Relevant as named R&S VNA-related products in PCB/interconnect probing and de-embedding context | [12] | No frequency range, port count, option code, order number or AI data-center DUT coverage is provided here |

| AI data-center backplane connector validation | R&S VNA + probing / fixture + de-embedding workflow | Sentry HD is described as a next-generation high-speed backplane connector platform purpose-built for AI data center architectures; VNA workflow should target connector SI metrics such as insertion loss, return loss, impedance and de-embedding | Sentry HD source does not provide part numbers, supported rate, pin count, impedance, insertion loss, crosstalk or compliance data | [2][3][11] |

### 推薦先賣
- AI data center interconnect targets are plausible because data-center server infrastructure uses connectors, cables and high-speed components for high-bandwidth data flow, complex data processing and high-performance computing.[37]
- Specific DUT targets include high-speed backplane connectors positioned for AI data center architectures, such as Amphenol Sentry HD, and high-speed I/O cable systems such as OverPass, which carries high-speed signals from ASIC packages to system endpoints.[2][25][30]
- The VNA fits where the workflow needs insertion loss, return loss, impedance, crosstalk-related SI work, and de-embedding for PCBs, sockets, board-to-board connectors, transmission lines and SoC validation fixtures.[3][20][26][31]
- R&S VNA positioning should be framed as a total measurement solution—VNA plus probe, mount-kit, de-embedding tool and local partner—rather than only an instrument-frequency discussion.[3][20]
